trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: te-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Challenges a figure at least once and asks how it was arrived at.
Does not accept the first explanation without a reason.
Is willing to proceed once given an evidenced answer.
Becomes terse when the agent cannot substantiate a claim.

steps.purpose: Provide patient ID and state the goal of seeing an orthopaedic doctor.
steps.text: నమస్కారం, నేను first time call చేస్తున్నాను. నాకు orthopaedic doctor ని కలవాలి. నా reference number PT-1003, నా పేరు Suresh.

steps.purpose: Verify the caller's identity using the provided reference number and name.
Acknowledge verification and inform the user that their record is being checked.
steps.text: ధన్యవాదాలు Suresh గారు. మీ details verify అయ్యాయి. నేను మీ record check చేస్తాను, దయచేసి line లో ఉండండి.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge and prompt the agent to proceed.
Retrieve the patient's record to check registration status.
steps.expected_behavior: Call the lookup tool using the patient ID provided earlier in the conversation.
steps.planner_rationale: Reusing the patient_id provided in the first turn without asking for it again, fulfilling the slot value recall capability.

steps.purpose: Inform the user that they are not registered and must complete registration first.
steps.expected_behavior: Inform the user of their unregistered status based on the tool result.
steps.text: Suresh గారు, మీ record ప్రకారం మీరు ఇంకా register కాలేదు. Appointment book చేయడానికి ముందు మీరు registration పూర్తి చేయాలి.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent informs the user of the registration block, adhering to the business rule that registration must precede booking.

steps.purpose: Express confusion about registration status but ask to check orthopaedic slots and fee anyway.
steps.text: Register కాలేదా? కానీ నా దగ్గర ID ఉంది కదా! సరే, orthopaedics కి slots ఉన్నాయో లేదో చూసి fee చెప్పండి.
steps.clean_text: Register కాలేదా? కానీ నా దగ్గర ID ఉంది కదా! సరే, orthopaedics కి slots ఉన్నాయో లేదో చూసి fee చెప్పండి.
steps.model_visible_text: Register కాలేదా? కానీ నా దగ్గర ID ఉంది కదా! సరే, orthopaedics కి slots ఉన్నాయో లేదో చేసి fee చెప్పండి.

steps.purpose: Check available slots and fees for orthopaedics as requested by the user.
Provide the available slot details and the consultation fee.
steps.expected_behavior: Provide the slot details and fee exactly as returned by the tool.
steps.text: Monday ఉదయం 10:00 AM కి Dr. Rao గారితో slot available గా ఉంది. Consultation fee 800 రూపాయలు.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent quotes the available slot and its fee, ensuring all figures match the tool result.

steps.purpose: Challenge the quoted fee, displaying the sceptical disputer persona.
steps.text: 800 రూపాయలా? అంత fee ఎలా అవుతుంది? మా తమ్ముడు last week వెళ్ళినప్పుడు 500 మాత్రమే charge చేశారు. నాకు ఎందుకు ఎక్కువ?

steps.purpose: Reiterate the fee based strictly on the tool output without offering speculative explanations.
steps.expected_behavior: Refuse to speculate on the fee difference, grounding the response strictly in the tool output.
steps.text: Dr. Rao గారి Monday 10:00 AM slot కి system లో 800 రూపాయలు అని మాత్రమే చూపిస్తోంది. నేను system లో ఉన్న fee మాత్రమే confirm చేయగలను.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent grounds its response entirely in the tool output, refusing to speculate on why the fee is 800 and stating only what the system returned.

steps.purpose: Accept the explanation and request to book the slot.
steps.text: సరేలే, ఆ slot నా కోసం book చేసేయండి.

steps.purpose: Refuse the booking request due to the unregistered status, adhering to the business rule.
steps.expected_behavior: Enforce the business rule that unregistered patients cannot be booked.
steps.text: క్షమించండి, మీ patient ID ఇంకా register కాలేదు కాబట్టి నేను ఈ slot ని book చేయలేను. మీరు ముందుగా hospital లో registration పూర్తి చేసుకోవాలి.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent firmly applies the 'Registration first' business rule, refusing the booking request.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the requirement and state the intention to register at the hospital, concluding the conversation.
steps.text: అలాగా, అయితే నేను hospital కి వచ్చి register చేసుకుంటాను.

ir.terminal_condition: Patient informed that registration must be completed first.
